Dear 2027 Scholarship Applicant,
Thank you for your interest in the Fox Chapel Golf Club Scholarship Foundation's 2027
scholarship program. We support post-secondary education for Club employees, children of
employees, and caddies through the generous donations of Club members. Awards are based on
academic performance, aptitude tests (e.g., ACT and SAT), school, community and work
involvement, financial need, the personal essay, recommendations, and any interview.
Scholarships are awarded for one year; eligible applicants may reapply in subsequent years. This
is a scholarship program, not an employee bonus.
Application Requirements and Deadline
To be eligible to apply, employees must have commenced employment at the Club before
January 1, 2027, and must have completed a minimum of 160 hours of work since their start
date. Caddies must have completed at least 15 rounds (preferably 20) during 2026 and be clearly
trending toward at least 15 rounds (preferably 20) in 2027. All applicants must be enrolled at a
qualified school for the Fall 2027 semester.
Submit the completed application and required materials by Friday, June 18, 2027, at 4:30 p.m.
Eastern Daylight Time. Late applications will not be considered. Missing documents will
invalidate the application unless an explanation is included with the submission. The committee
will not follow up to obtain missing documents.
Checklist of Required Documents
Your application will be considered complete if it includes the following:
• Complete the 2027 application digitally. Handwritten applications and previous years'
application forms are not eligible.
• One letter of recommendation from a person outside Fox Chapel Golf Club. Letters from
FCGC personnel do not qualify. Provide the recommender's name, address and phone
number on the application.
• Personal essay (1-2 pages), in your own words: describe your educational and career goals,
how the scholarship would help, and significant experiences that shaped your aspirations.
• First two pages of your FAFSA summary, including your Student Aid Index. If you did not
submit the FAFSA, explain why.
• School acceptance letter or financial aid offer letter; include a school financial aid estimate
if that is the available aid documentation. Explain any unavailable documents.
• Complete the full-year school cost matrix, list each scholarship and grant by name and
amount, and show the total cost, total scholarships and grants, and amount not funded.
• Email a digital photo of the applicant to wparks@foxchapelgolfclub.com, as directed on the
application.

Tips for a Strong Application
A strong application gives the committee a clear understanding of your achievements, financial
circumstances and goals. Please:
• Ensure that all sections of the application are completed thoroughly.
• Provide specific details about your academic achievements, work experience, and community
involvement.
• Write the personal essay in your own words so the committee can understand your
motivations and aspirations.
• Double-check your application for accuracy and completeness before submission.
Financial Need
Financial need is an important consideration. Some families may not qualify for federal financial
aid but still face substantial educational costs. The Student Aid Index is a guideline in evaluating
financial need. Please explain your circumstances clearly and accurately.
Use your school's estimated cost for one academic year, including tuition, fees, room and board,
and related expenses such as books and transportation. List all scholarships and grants with the
name and amount of each, total the scholarships and grants, and show the remaining amount not
funded. Attach the supporting documents listed above and explain any pending aid, missing
documents or special circumstances.
Next Steps
After the deadline, the scholarship committee will review the applications. Selected applicants
may be invited to an interview to discuss their motivations, character and future goals.
Submitting an application does not guarantee an interview or a scholarship. An interview does
not guarantee a scholarship.
For questions, call the Club Front Office so your call can be directed appropriately, or email
scholarshipfoundation@foxchapelgolfclub.com.
Thank you for your interest. The Foundation wishes you well in your educational pursuits.
Sincerely,
The Fox Chapel Golf Club Scholarship Foundation
